fields.description: Stable slug for this phase; unique within the workflow. Carried onto the Task (backend_ref / phase_key) so the engine can resolve the transition on completion.
fields.label: Phase Key

fields.description: agentic = an agent runs a governed turn. milestone = a human gate (no agent). mechanical = run required_skills in sequence (no model).
fields.label: Execution Mode

fields.description: The Role that owns this transition. The dispatcher routes the Task to the active Agent Profile whose discriminator_role matches. Empty for milestone / human gates.
fields.label: Agent Role

fields.description: Verification list checked by the permission matrix at execution time. NOT the routing key (agent_role is the router).
fields.label: Required Skills

fields.description: Jinja2 template rendered against the work-item's fields to build the task instruction. Test-rendered at save (validate) so a bad template fails loudly here, not as an opaque runner_lost later.
fields.label: Prompt Template (Jinja)

fields.description: Phase 2 (AND-join): when set, the engine advances the work-item only after ALL sibling phase tasks complete. Not honored in Phase 1 (sequential-only).
fields.label: Wait For All Tasks (AND-join)
